18.summary: Jones, just arrived at Bombay on the Sapphire, tells Minto that Malcolm has already gone into the Persian Gulf under Minto's authority; to avoid 'the appearance of clashing authorities in Persia' he suspends his own departure until Minto's orders, while noting that he holds the King's commission, that the French are at Tehran, and that only His Majesty's ministers can be accredited.

21.en:
English. Same key as /18. {Persia} = code word 8674. [x] = restored. The copy /19 carries this clear text in its
margin, written at the time; the reading below was made from the key alone and was then checked against it.

Ninth paragraph of Gen. Malcolm's instructions: You will be furnished with credentials as Envoy or Ambassador from
myself to the Co[u]rt of {Persia} and to the Pashaw of Bagdad, to be presented in the event of your finding it
practicable and expedient to repair [i]n person to those places, and in the event of your finding neither Sir
Harford Jones nor any other person accreditted by His Majesty in {Persia}.

system: Homophonic substitution of letters by figures 2-99 (2-5 per letter, u/v and i/j merged), words ended by stops and figures joined by commas, with a few 3-4 figure code words (8674 Persia, 4040 French, 630 Bombay).
